subject.title: Página de autor - Inyectar contenido en la biografia (sección sobre el autor)

question: Should this issue be handled as a narrow Zafón biography-field change now, or folded into the broader author licensing/content strategy tracked in https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/issues/6515?
rationale: The code shape is small, but the remaining work includes content provenance and production data handling that automation should not choose while the broader licensing issue is open.

options.title: Recreate the narrow biography PR
options.body: Add optional `author.biography`, render it only in the collapsed About block, and load reviewed owned copy for Carlos Ruiz Zafón without changing `description`.

options.title: Fold into author licensing work
options.body: Keep this issue open but defer implementation until the broader Wikipedia/Commons strategy decides how author biographies and images should be sourced.

options.title: Close as out of scope
options.body: Close only if maintainers no longer want per-author long biography copy on author pages.

recommendation.title: Recreate the narrow biography PR
recommendation.body: Add optional `author.biography`, render it only in the collapsed About block, and load reviewed owned copy for Carlos Ruiz Zafón without changing `description`.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn has the clearest recent evidence on the related licensing decision that gates the content-source choice.
